QuestInfo.name: An Empty Space
QuestInfo.0: The duo learned that the priests live extended lives while inside the temple, but perish quickly should they ever leave... as #p2400008# did. They went to speak with his brother, #p2400007#, to make sure he was okay.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400007# volunteered to take care of the dowsing from then on. They would just need to retrieve #p2400008#'s dowsing tool from Shadowvale first.
QuestInfo.2: Filling in the role of dowser was easy enough, but losing a comrade was no sweet task. The loss of #p2400008# weighed heavily on what was once a sanctuary.

0.0: #face2##p2400008# taught me how to do his job while you two were out and about... He must've known something was gonna happen all along.

yes.0: #face2#I just want to find #p2400008#'s dowsing tool. I don't need it, or anything, but it was my brother's. I feel like it should be here...
